documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On October 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries presented its FY19 and Q1FY20 results, delivering 3% reported revenue growth in FY19 and 13% growth in Q1FY20. The international business crossed the $20 million revenue milestone in FY19 driven by 54% growth and strong demand in the U.S. market. Management expects to achieve double-digit growth with margin expansion in FY20 alongside planned capex of Rs. 30-35 crore.

guidance.claim: Vadilal Industries expects to incur capital expenditure of Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve double digit revenue growth with margin expansion driven by international business.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Management expects another good year in FY20 by leveraging the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: Focus on developing domestic business and lower input costs are expected to drive growth.
guidance.quote: Continued focus on developing domestic business and lower input costs expected to drive growth

guidance.claim: The company maintains its positive business outlook going forward.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic ice cream consumption was impacted in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions extending winter.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double-digit growth in summer and 25% international revenue expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for quality Indian products is driving strong volume growth in U.S. ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: Vadilal delivered ~27% revenue growth in Q3 FY19, driven by 12% domestic growth and 71% international growth.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q3, we have delivered ~27% growth in revenues – including 12% growth in the domestic business and 71% growth in the international business that continues to expand rapidly from a low base.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues contributed 35% to turnover during Q3 FY19 and crossed Rs. 100 crore in 9M FY19.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues contributed 35% to the turnover during Q3, and crossed the Rs. 100 crore milestone in the first nine months, driven by deeper proliferation of Vadilal ice creams and processed food products within the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is reverting to historical trends following temporary impacts from operating environment changes.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: International business has witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution.
demand_outlook.quote: International business has witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution and is selling products focused on Indian diaspora in the US and other geographies

capex_expansion.claim: Vadilal Industries expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on capex during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company does not anticipate any major capital expenditure for capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY19 is approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and higher international operations contribution.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Management plans to consider price increases in the second half of the year due to higher milk prices.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Personnel costs grew significantly last year due to U.S. operations having a base of over 50 employees.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 FY19 compared to 40% in Q3 FY18.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for the first nine months expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Vadilal has secured key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season, ensuring clear visibility of input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Having already closed key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season, we have clear visibility of input costs and expect strong contribution from sales.

margins_costs.claim: During Q2, gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices continue to be subdued for the next season, which should benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal expanded its capacity over recent years from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal is present in 55,000 retail outlets across 26 states in India.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we are present in 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states across the country.

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal products currently reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

capital_allocation.claim: The company reconstituted outstanding debt to extend loan tenure and lower debt costs.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: Management plans to use operational surplus to restructure debt and improve working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: Leveraging surplus generated by operations to rationalize/ restructure debt and improve working capital management

risks_headwinds.claim: Severe weather conditions extending winter till late March impacted Q4 ice cream sales in core markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Milk prices are currently at higher levels.
risks_headwinds.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Q3 is seasonally the company's weakest quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Another key achievement is the significantly lower loss in Q3, which is our seasonally weakest quarter – reflective of the increasing diversification in our business profile.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to risks including regulatory changes and political or economic developments.
risks_headwinds.quote: Certain statements in this document may be forward-looking statements. Such forward- looking statements are subject to certain risks and uncertainties, like regulatory changes, local political or economic developments, and many other factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from those contemplated by the relevant forward-looking statements.

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal Industries expects capital expenditure of Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal expects double digit growth with higher international contribution leading to margin expansion.
management_commitments.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

management_commitments.claim: Estimated capex for FY19 is approximately Rs. 35 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
